description: Query rows from a subgraph table (max 200 rows), reading the open /v1 surface — { rows, next_cursor, tip } envelope, cursor-paginated (no offset). Filters support operators: "amount.gte": "1000", "sender.neq": "SP...", "name.like": "%token%". Available operators: eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, like. Every page with rows returns next_cursor (null only when empty): pass it back as `cursor` to read the next page. To TAIL new rows (no streaming over MCP), poll with cursor = next_cursor ?? the cursor you sent. Fetch one row by id with {"_id": "<id>"}. The same rows are readable over HTTP at GET /v1/subgraphs/<name>/<table>; hand that URL to third parties.

count.description: If true, return row count instead of rows

cursor.description: Resume from a previous response's nextCursor

filters.description: Column filters — plain values or with operators (e.g. {"amount.gte": "1000", "sender": "SP..."})

name: subgraphs_query
